data.title: One Residence
data.about:
One Residence at Downtown Dubai isn’t just an exclusive address; it’s your gateway to a life that’s both exciting and rewarding. Ginco Properties proudly presents this eagerly awaited project in the heart of the city. With luxurious living options, including spacious studios, elegant 1 bedroom apartments, stylish 2 bedroom units, and expansive 2 bedroom plus maids' quarters as well as an exclusive penthouse. One Residence by Ginco Properties is designed to cater to your every need.

Conveniently located in Downtown Dubai within walking distance to the iconic Dubai Mall, residents can enjoy the perfect blend of urban convenience and sophisticated living. One Residence Apartments for Sale offer exceptional value for the luxury and amenities provided.

One Residence boasts incredible amenities designed to enhance your lifestyle, making it the ideal choice for modern living. The concept of 'One' permeates every aspect of the luxurious living experience at One Residence. Here, residents thrive as part of an exclusive inner circle, where each person's contribution enriches the collective experience.

characteristics_module.title: A 'One in a Million' Home at One Residence.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Luxurious Living Options: Ginco Properties' One Residence offers spacious studios, one-bedroom apartments, two-bedroom units, and two-bedroom plus maids' quarters.
  • Prime Location: Located within walking distance of Dubai Mall, providing urban convenience and sophisticated living.
  • High-Quality Finishing: Modern finishing with high-quality materials.
  • Equipped Kitchens: All units feature equipped kitchens for added convenience.
  • World-Class Amenities: Exceptional amenities designed to enhance your lifestyle.
  • Central Hub: Located in Downtown Dubai, home to Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and Dancing Fountains.
  • Luxurious Lifestyle: Known for upscale hotels, leisure points, and shopping centres.
  • Well-Connected: Strategically located along Sheikh Zayed Road, connected to key areas.
  • Popular Rental Area: Second most popular for luxury rentals after Dubai Marina.
  • Vibrant Community: A mix of high-rise and villa living, bustling with activity year-round.

location_tile.title: All in "One" Place at Downtown Dubai!
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Situated in the vibrant heart of Downtown Dubai, One Residence by Ginco Properties offers a unique investment opportunity in a globally celebrated location. Downtown Dubai is the dynamic core of the city, featuring iconic landmarks like the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and the Dancing Fountains, creating a lively and engaging environment.

Strategically positioned along Sheikh Zayed Road, E11, and near Business Bay, Downtown Dubai provides excellent connectivity to other key commercial and residential areas. This bustling neighborhood is ideal for non-drivers and frequent travelers, offering a wealth of amenities including upscale hotels, trendy leisure spots, and expansive shopping centers. Downtown Dubai truly embodies the essence of "the centre of now."

5 Mins to Dubai Mall
10 Mins to Jumeirah Beach
15 Mins to Dubai Creek Harbour
20 Mins to Burj Al Arab
